title: Exact conservative sections on a geometric strict-local base
statement: Let s be a geometric point of a scheme S [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-geometric-point], K a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], and u:Spec K\to S_(s) a map to its strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Write t for the composite to S and E=S_(s)\times_S Spec K [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then global sections on abelian etale sheaves on E [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] preserves finite colimits and reflects isomorphisms.

source.place: Step 4 of corrected Tag 0EZV; Tags 09AY and 03PN

proof.text: Apply the geometry theorem to get affineness, closed separably closed points, and surjective global germs. The affine exactness theorem gives finite-colimit preservation. Equality of global maps gives equality on the terminal etale object, via the canonical global-sections/evaluation isomorphism. Naturalities of germs and epimorphic germ maps imply equality on each stalk. Geometric points are jointly faithful, so global sections is faithful; it reflects monos and epis, and balancedness of the abelian sheaf category makes it reflect isomorphisms.

theorem strictLocalBase_sections_exact_conservative
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsSepClosed K]
    (u : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s) :
    let E := pullback (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
      (u ≫ Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)
    PreservesFiniteColimits (Sheaf.Γ E.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ∧
      (Sheaf.Γ E.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).ReflectsIsomorphisms
